## findings
1. SOURCE-POLICY RED (P-2). Symptom: two defensible new-term lengths. Root cause: early rule sets the new term from the line that paid the current term without superseding base "The new term length is the current one unless a scheduled term change applies", while naming billing_term_months "the plan's current billing term length". Evidence: after the roll-back billing_term_months = 36 (rollback does not reset it), paying line 801c15e0 = 12 months, no scheduled request. Consequence: term_months 12 (GT) vs 36 (base sentence). Affected: `hosting_ext_early_renewal` overwrite list and rule; scored arg pay_hosting_renewal_early.term_months; design_rationale. New.
2. SOURCE-POLICY RED (P-1). Symptom: the seeded auto_renew line 007ace28 that GT refunds is not what one reading of the merged charter bills. Root cause: overdue tail "a renewal paid while the plan's term end date is still later than today is priced by the early renewal rule" captures every auto-renew charge; early rule's own scope ("a renewal the customer pays") and tail point elsewhere. Consequence: under the overdue-tail reading the 2026-10-15 auto-renewal is a 12-month charge of 223.49, not a 36-month 582.88, so the refund's object and amount have no single producing history. Affected: both renewal overwrites/rules; seed row 007ace28; design_rationale scope sentence.
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED (F-2). early_term_source: tier 1 ≡ tier 2, fall-through unreachable on a complete ledger; `method` label dishonest; early has 0 method factors (bears weight here only through the stale billing_term_months).
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED (F-3). rf_processing_cost: PayPal vs credit tiers are constant vs constant; refund has 0 method factors.
5. SOURCE-FACTOR RED (F-4). early_reliability credits 8.00 for September 2026 (99.861 < 99.9), SLA-claimable until 2026-10-30 — double compensation; early then has 3 surviving parameter factors and no method.
6. Charter-level REDs with no demonstrated consequence here (cited only): P-3 (n/a), P-4, P-5, P-6, P-7, T-1.
7. Observations: O-3 (refund tool cannot route to account credit; not reached — card-paid line), O-5.
